Abbas Sheikh & another ------ Defendant-Appellants. 
Vs. 
Md. Abu Hossain Sarkar and others ------Plaintiffs-Respondents.
full_judgment: 2. The defendants No. 1 and 6 contested the plaintiff's suit contending that Kasimuddin alone held the disputed jot under one Meharuddin by a registered kabuliyat. Imaruddin had no interest in the jot and consequently the sister of Imaruddin had no interest in the jot. Kasimuddin's widow never settled the suit land by executing any patta in favour of Ayenuddin nor did she realise any rent therefrom. The defendants were allegedly in possession of the suit land and that Ayenuddin or his successors in interest of the plaintiffs never possessed the suit land adversely to their interest within their knowledge The contesting defendant No. 1 and 6 who were respectively aged about 21 and 19 at the time of the trial of the suit were minors when the patta was executed in favour of Ayenuddin and the said patta was not binding on them and there could be no adverse possession of the suit land by dint or the said patta at least as against the contesting defendants No 1 and 6.
